info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Liquidity Risk Model Update API enables users to modify existing liquidity risk models by specifying unique parameters. This operation allows financial institutions to adjust model specifications to reflect current market conditions or internal policy changes. Typical consumers include risk management teams and financial analysts who require real-time updates to maintain the accuracy of their risk assessments. This API streamlines the process of model management and ensures that organizations can effectively respond to evolving financial landscapes.

patch.summary: Update a specific liquidity risk model.
patch.description: This operation allows you to modify the details of a specific liquidity risk model identified by its unique resource ID. Use this endpoint to keep your model data up to date.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the liquidity risk model with the specified identifier (RES-100045). It requires a JSON payload adhering to the schema defined in the components section. Ensure that the fields included in the request match the expected data types and formats to successfully apply the changes.
